nodes.label: gdtoolkit 4.5.0 (gdformat/gdlint)
nodes.rationale: Must stay in sync with rev in .pre-commit-config.yaml.

nodes.label: Modular Audio System
nodes.rationale: Data-driven, separating content, routing and playback policy so it can be copied between projects without gameplay dependencies.

nodes.label: Start-up navigation only in boot.gd
nodes.rationale: Autoloads also run when a single scene is started (F6), so navigation in an autoload _ready() would hijack scene debugging.

nodes.label: SceneKey values appended at end
nodes.rationale: Exported enum values are stored as numbers, so inserting values would shift saved references.

nodes.label: New behaviour needs tests (TemplateTest for integration)
nodes.norm_label: new behaviour needs tests (templatetest for integration)

nodes.label: Direct audio references (AudioStream/AudioCue/AudioSet)
nodes.rationale: Direct preload fails at parse time on typo; IDs only warn.

nodes.label: check_ref() reference validation
nodes.rationale: Store ids not typed resources so a moved file shows as readable validation message instead of load error.

nodes.label: Debug autoload (overlay and console)
nodes.rationale: Console pauses game because polled input isn't blocked by GUI focus.

nodes.label: Log levels and per-category filtering
nodes.rationale: warn and error are always logged so problems can't be hidden by accident.

nodes.label: Autoload order
nodes.rationale: Log first (depends on nothing), SignalBus second (others emit from _ready), Debug last (uses all others).

nodes.label: GameState
nodes.rationale: Only code setting get_tree().paused and Input.mouse_mode, so pause/mouse logic never fights.

nodes.label: SceneRegistry
nodes.rationale: Holds paths not scenes so nothing loads at startup; keys appended at end because exported values are numbers.

nodes.label: TemplateTest base class
nodes.rationale: Runs GUT with PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS so pausing doesn't freeze tests; disables adopt_standalone.

nodes.label: Autoload name vs class_name gotcha
nodes.rationale: Same name makes the global ambiguous, hence class MainRoot for autoload SceneManager.

nodes.label: Script checker (check_scripts.gd)
nodes.rationale: Replaces --check-only, which gives false Identifier not found for autoloads.

nodes.label: tools/check.sh
nodes.rationale: Scans logs for ERROR: lines because Godot exits 0 on load failures.

nodes.label: rename_project.gd tool
nodes.rationale: Rename before first real run because project name decides the user:// data folder.

nodes.label: SignalBus
nodes.rationale: Typed signals so typos fail at parse time instead of silently doing nothing.

nodes.label: Template setup workflow (template-setup.yml)
nodes.rationale: Runs once on first push to rename project; cannot delete itself because GitHub's token can't change workflow files.

nodes.label: Atomic save writes
nodes.rationale: Write .tmp then rename so a crash mid-write leaves the previous save intact.

nodes.label: Bus vs direct signal guideline
nodes.rationale: Bus for unrelated listeners; direct signals for parent/child, since routing everything through the bus obscures data flow.

nodes.label: Save file format (JSON + from_native)
nodes.rationale: Chosen for diffability, type safety, and safety: objects never decoded so shared saves can't run code. var_to_bytes and plain JSON compared.

nodes.label: Direct resource playback (play_sound*)
nodes.rationale: IDs for game-wide sounds give one place to retune; direct references keep scene folders self-contained and movable.

nodes.label: Follow emitters (play_follow, not pooled)
nodes.rationale: Not pooled because they map 1:1 to world objects.

nodes.label: Autoload systems table (Log, SignalBus, RngManager, Audio, SettingsManager, GameState, SceneManager, Debug)
nodes.norm_label: autoload systems table (log, signalbus, rngmanager, audio, settingsmanager, gamestate, scenemanager, debug)

nodes.label: GameState owns pause and mouse mode
nodes.norm_label: gamestate owns pause and mouse mode

nodes.label: Audio known limitations (cooldown not enforced, randi not RngManager)
nodes.norm_label: audio known limitations (cooldown not enforced, randi not rngmanager)

nodes.label: Debugging in VS Code (godot-tools)
nodes.rationale: Uses port 6010 to avoid clash with editor debugger on 6007.

nodes.label: Boot flow (main.tscn / boot.gd)
nodes.rationale: Start-up navigation lives only in boot.gd since autoloads also run for F6 and would redirect every debugged scene.

nodes.label: InputBindings / rebinding
nodes.rationale: Conflicts swap so no action ends up unbound; keys stored as physical positions.

nodes.label: Localization (gettext PO)
nodes.rationale: PO over CSV: loaded directly without generated .translation files that error on cold start; plurals, context, tooling.

nodes.label: Settings menu
nodes.rationale: Preview/Apply/Back: changes apply immediately but only Apply saves; Back restores snapshot.

nodes.label: Save versions and migrations
nodes.rationale: One-step migrations chained in order so each only knows its neighbour; never edit after release.

nodes.label: Export presets (Windows/Linux/Web)
nodes.rationale: Web without threads so it runs on static hosts lacking COOP/COEP headers.

nodes.label: Exported builds .remap handling
nodes.rationale: Uses ResourceLoader.list_directory() because DirAccess sees only .remap names in exports.

nodes.label: 32-bit FNV-1a hashing
nodes.rationale: Gives the same results on every platform.

nodes.label: RNG stream (rng_stream.gd)
nodes.rationale: Separate stream per system so adding a roll in one doesn't shift others.
